verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's first-party docs describe workspace budgets: dollar caps over daily, weekly, monthly or lifetime intervals that automatically block requests once reached. That is a real hard spend limit at the team or workspace level. Community users separately confirm billing caps and per-key limits. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of per-key spend limits (only community-attested), per-user budget controls, and detail on alerting or how limits are managed through the API.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set hard budgets and spend limits per key, team, or user

citations.quote: Workspace budgets let you cap how much a workspace can spend on OpenRouter inference. Set a dollar limit on any combination of intervals — daily, weekly, monthly, or lifetime — and OpenRouter blocks requests automatically once a limit is reached.
One thing that OpenRouter makes easy is the ability to manage API keys (mint new ones, expiry/limits per key, etc.)
